title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract Deductible Schedule
content:
On every Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract plan one deductible applies per repair visit. The deductible on a given plan is the one chosen at sale from that plan's deductible options and printed on the plan; on some plans it is waived when the repair is done at the selling Kestrel dealer.

| Plan | Deductible options (USD) | Unit to which one deductible applies | Waived when repaired at the selling Kestrel dealer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | 100.00 or 250.00 | Per repair visit | No |
| Kestrel Care Gold | 0.00, 100.00 or 250.00 | Per repair visit | No |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | 0.00, 100.00 or 250.00 | Per repair visit | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | 0.00, 50.00 or 100.00 | Per repair visit | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | 0.00, 50.00 or 100.00 | Per repair visit | Yes |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | 0.00 or 50.00 | Per repair visit | Yes |

### Points of judgement

- **Which amount is the deductible?** The amount chosen from the plan's options and written on the plan, not any other figure in the plan's row.
- **How many deductibles on one visit?** One, because the unit is the repair visit on every plan, whatever the number of repair lines on that visit.
- **Where does the waiver apply?** Only on the plans marked Yes, and only where the repair is done at the selling Kestrel dealer; a repair at another Kestrel dealer or at an independent facility is not a repair at the selling dealer.

### Hypothetical illustration

A plan written with a hypothetical deductible of 100.00 on Kestrel Care Gold Plus: a visit at the selling Kestrel dealer carries no deductible because the plan's waiver applies, and a visit at another Kestrel dealer carries one deductible of 100.00. The same visits on a Kestrel Care Gold plan written at 100.00 carry one deductible of 100.00 each, because that plan has no selling-dealer waiver.
